name: AutoShark SharkMinter mints on donated balances (May 2021)
summary: SharkMinter.mintFor, a PancakeBunny-style minter, converts its entire LP, SHARK and WBNB balances (balanceOf(this)) into SHARK-BNB liquidity and mints SHARK in proportion to that value, so tokens donated to the minter inflate the reward. The attacker flash-borrowed WBNB, sent WBNB and SHARK to the minter, and claimed a tiny vault reward that minted 138M SHARK, which it sold into the SHARK/WBNB and SHARK/BUSD pairs.

loss.notes: Net depletion of the two SHARK liquidity pools that bought the unbacked mint: SHARK/WBNB pair 0x1fd789fa513871cb89aa655f11ec777cad1784a0 lost 1361.653259072555291801 WBNB and SHARK/BUSD pair 0xea0d470d4af27123ca870c70cf41853a6e6e8313 lost 415820.823404016329197845 BUSD in the anchor transaction; the SHARK they received was freshly minted. The flash-loan pair 0x58f876857a02d6762e0101bb5c46a8c1ed44dc16 was repaid and is not a victim.

ageReset.description: Direct SharkMinter runtime with the balanceOf-based mint valuation; the owner wired it in within minutes (vault setMinter at block 7683063, minter setMinter(vault) at 7683065, setSharkPerProfitBNB at 7683039), which makes it operational without changing the defect.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age history. Verified SharkMinter (source-6): mintFor(flip, withdrawalFee, performanceFee, to, , boostRate) (onlyMinter) pulls the fee, then calls tokenToSharkBNB(flip, IBEP20(flip).balanceOf(address(this))), whose flip branch removes liquidity and swaps the minter's whole token balances into SHARK and WBNB and generateFlipToken() adds all of them as SHARK-BNB liquidity; contribution = helper.tvlInBNB(flipToken, sharkBNBAmount) and mintShark = amountSharkToMint(contribution)*boostRate/10000, then mint() mints SHARK plus 15% for dev. Balances donated to the minter therefore count as fee profit. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 7698696, index 62): EOA 0xd9c7efe29f3e90ce3630ea1c665217c7ab298a3b flash-swaps WBNB from 0x58f876857a02d6762e0101bb5c46a8c1ed44dc16 into its contract 0x22de6648685e4e47fd944e68b264e0e0667e2e00, which buys SHARK, transfers WBNB and SHARK to the minter, and calls getReward() on vault StrategyCompoundFLIP 0xa007d347f2e55d731e101aae64722c321b2b80dc; the vault calls minter.mintFor (0x8e9c17e8) and the minter mints 138000000.102256780737044220 SHARK (SHARK 0xf7321385a461c4490d5526d83e63c366b149cb15 Transfer-from-zero logs), then the contract sells SHARK into the SHARK/WBNB and SHARK/BUSD pairs. eth_call at block 7698695: vault minter() = 0x37ee638d..., minter isMinter(vault) = true, SHARK owner() = the minter. Earliest-use scan: eth_getLogs SHARK Transfer from 0x0, blocks 7682992..7702991, groups into 3194 minting transactions; source-1 mints 138000000.10 SHARK and the next largest in the window is 34553.46 (0x91721fa08f2857eb1aeb960e84e79f34d29dd65db4431640ef741332404ec36a), consistent with ordinary harvests; no earlier transaction shows a donation-scale mint. Identity/age: eth_getCode empty at block 7682991; keccak256 of runtime 0x9bf5e24cf1ea8a8734f3cf2aa23440c2b709f70ee159f0be3a41f6527348e45e at deployment block 7682992 and pre-exploit block 7698695; creation tx source-7 (index 36) by 0xd9ebb6d95f3d8f3da0b922bb05e0e79501c13554, top-level. The source has no proxy, delegatecall or selfdestruct. Etherscan V2 txlist of the minter (blocks 7682992..7698696, 13 txs) holds only owner configuration: setSharkPerProfitBNB (7683039) and setMinter calls (7683049..7684056; 0x6258faa53b91c7ab9226e0a237a89cf44ae432d8ec232a83555c67d5d0552a87 authorises the vault at 7683065); the vault's setMinter history is 0x330df11d... (7655546), 0x4acd1d29... (7679200), 0xd422c355... (7680569), then this minter (0xfb674c3f48cdb6901a9da1573ed464c2d785dbfdd0b80a9d97101eeaa07cb28a, block 7683063). These wiring writes make the minter operational and do not introduce the balance-based valuation, so deployment supplies the age (the latest wiring is 73 blocks later).

Reviewed loss from the source-1 receipt. Net Transfer deltas: SHARK/WBNB pair 0x1fd789fa513871cb89aa655f11ec777cad1784a0 (Panther factory 0x670f55c6284c629c23bae99f585e3f17e8b9fc31, token0 WBNB, token1 SHARK) -1361653259072555291801 WBNB and +54809606.035967533061400068 SHARK; SHARK/BUSD pair 0xea0d470d4af27123ca870c70cf41853a6e6e8313 -415820823404016329197845 BUSD and +55190094.470084216590548313 SHARK; the BUSD is swapped for 1152.635384272552300397 WBNB in pair 0x6af4c4433474b2f8ba385ad62b23299c82846783 (not a victim: it receives BUSD in return); flash lender 0x58f87685... ends +300.902708124373119458 WBNB (repayment plus fee); attacker EOA ends +2213.386128148219804340 WBNB. The attacker made no other successful exploit transaction (Etherscan txlist of the EOA). WBNB valued at DefiLlama 342.92003040915495 USD (source-5), BUSD at par.

Verified SharkMinter source at https://bscscan.com/address/0x37ee638d85e420532e35cd9dd831166514855e6d#code; reproduce Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode chainid=56. Compiler v0.6.12+commit.27d51765, optimizer 200 runs. SHA-256 of returned SourceCode: 29b906a9bb82e702d724f272dff768fa308ffd9171c159683c38d94deda7ebd9. Inspect mintFor, tokenToSharkBNB, _flipToSharkBNBFlip, generateFlipToken and mint.
